newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium ends higher on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium ends higher on weaker yen.

text.p: TOCOM aluminium futures closed higher across the board on Wednesday on the yen's renewed decline against the dollar, local traders said.

Aluminium prices were 1.0 to 2.0 yen higher, with the benchmark February contract up 1.0 yen at 206.6 yen per kg. The day's volume was 5,334 lots, down from 8,290 on Tuesday and 19,645 on Monday, the day of the contract's launch.
All months opened higher after the yen's losses overnight and bullish sentiment was maintained throughout the day, traders said.
The dollar surged to around 126.70 yen in late afternoon Tokyo trade, against 125.90 yen on late Monday afternoon.
"The weaker yen accelerated buying orders from local investors. The yen/dollar rate will be a major factor this week," a brokerage house trader said.
Local trade houses were reluctant to conduct arbitrage trades today between TOCOM aluminium futures and the local physical market, traders said.
